integrity: The displayed formula has a complete analytic proof and a separate finite exact enumeration; only the analytic proof supports the infinite-family claim. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real unit-edge odd prisms only. Determines the maximum facet-vertex count and multiplicity, not all facet counts or the full face vector. The general facet criterion is prior work; unindexed overlap remains possible.
title: Vertex-rich facets of odd-prism transportation balls
